capabilityBoundaries: REST metadata adapters expose canonicalObjects:false; they do not reconstruct arbitrary signed Git DAGs under original IDs.
GitHub beforeOid GraphQL CAS is atomic; Azure oldObjectId is per-ref. GitLab/Gitea have weaker file guards, and Bitbucket lacks compare-and-swap.
Snapshot submodules are unsupported; Azure/Gitea action writes support regular files, GitLab regular/executable files.
OpenPGP signing requires a registered key-provider extension. Native SSH/external filter/hook execution is never implicit.
Linked-worktree .git indirection needs an explicit common-directory adapter; alternates require explicit ODB grants.
Browser File System Access cannot claim native OS lockfile/executable/symlink guarantees; OPFS-handle tests are not OS-picker evidence.
Reference collaboration server uses one owner per journal and no tombstone GC. STUN/TURN origins require separate explicit grants.
OAuth applications, token brokers, provider registrations and deployed CSP headers must be provisioned by the host; fixtures do not provision them.

issues.title: [SF-A25-T05.8] Implement write-tree and commit creation with identity and amend
